Parameters ---------- html : str The input HTML string to be parsed. Returns ------- list[str] A list of all tags found in the input string. Each tag includes the surrounding angle brackets (e.g., "

"). """ if not isinstance(html, str): # Gracefully handle non‑string input by returning an empty list. return [] # `findall` returns all non‑overlapping matches of the pattern. return _TAG_RE.findall(html)
